about.title: Belmont Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Belmont's crash pattern tells a familiar story: with 52 injury collisions and 60 people hurt in the most recent year on record, most of the activity clusters on corridors like Ralston Avenue, El Camino Real, Old County Road, and the US-101 stretch through town, with Friday evening rush being a common flashpoint. San Mateo County's mix of commuter traffic, local shopping corridors, and highway on-ramps creates plenty of opportunity for rear-end collisions, T-bones at signalized intersections, and lane-change crashes. If you were injured in one of these, what happens in the days right after matters. Insurance adjusters move fast, and a recorded statement given too early can be used against you later. LawProactive doesn't practice law — we simply connect you, at no charge, with an independent California personal injury attorney who can evaluate your situation and help you understand your options before you say anything to an insurer.

whyChoose.title: Why Belmont Residents Turn to LawProactive

items.title: The Clock Is Already Running
items.desc: California generally gives you two years from the crash date to file a personal injury suit, but claims involving a government-owned road or vehicle can require notice in as little as six months. Connecting with an attorney early helps make sure a shorter deadline doesn't quietly slip by.

items.title: Fault Doesn't Have to Be All-or-Nothing
items.desc: California follows pure comparative fault, meaning you can still recover damages even if you were partly responsible for the crash, though your share of fault reduces the amount. An independent attorney can help make sure insurers don't overstate your share to shrink your claim.

items.title: No Ceiling on Pain-and-Suffering Damages
items.desc: Unlike some states, California places no cap on non-economic damages like pain and suffering in most car accident cases. Attorneys in our network work on contingency, so there's no upfront cost to find out what your claim may be worth.

items.question: I was in a crash on Ralston Avenue during evening rush hour — what should I do first?
items.answer: Seek medical care first, even if injuries seem minor, since documentation matters later. Avoid giving a recorded statement to the other driver's insurer until you've spoken with an attorney, and try to preserve any photos, witness names, or dashcam footage from the scene. LawProactive can connect you with an independent attorney at no cost to help sort out next steps.

items.question: Does it matter if my accident happened on El Camino Real versus a city street?
items.answer: It can. El Camino Real is a state highway, so depending on the specifics, a government entity could be involved in maintenance or design issues, which may trigger a much shorter claims deadline than the standard two years. An attorney can help identify whether that applies to your situation.

items.question: What does it cost to talk to an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free service that connects injured people with independent attorneys, and those attorneys typically work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation. There's no fee to get matched and no obligation to move forward.
